prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: A researcher uses several procedures to separate a rock sample into different chemicals. A mass of 50 grams of one chemical is produced. If this chemical cannot be separated into other chemicals, then it is best described as
A. a compound.
B. a mixture.
C. a solution.
D. an element.
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
